scenes.heading: Building a portfolio that attracts the right clients

sents.d: Building a portfolio that attracts the right clients
Showing your best 10-15 pieces beats showing everything you've made.

scenes.heading: Filter for the clients you want

sents.d: A portfolio's purpose is to filter for the specific type of client and project you want more of, not to prove you can do everything — a portfolio full of unrelated styles and industries makes it harder for a potential client to see themselves in your work.

If you don't have paid client work yet, well-executed spec projects (redesigning a real brand's identity as a personal project, clearly labeled as unsolicited) can demonstrate skill and thinking process just as effectively as paid work.
For each portfolio piece, briefly noting the challenge and your specific solution — not just the final image — helps potential clients understand your thinking, not just your visual style.

take: Show focused work and explain the problem you solved.
